name: Spicy Garlic-Miso Steak Bites with Pepper & Onion Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl along with miso paste, soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
1 ½ tbsp miso paste, red
soy sauce
2 tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Wash and dry bell pepper. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice. Place in another small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook, stirring occasionally, until desired doneness, 3-4 minutes for medium. Transfer to a plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for the next step.)

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, green onions, and cauliflower; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 (340 g) bag frozen, riced cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: When the cauliflower rice is done, remove from heat, add additional soy sauce, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and steak bites between plates. Enjoy!
